# Markdown Formatting Showcase

## Headers

### This is H3
#### This is H4

## Text Formatting

**Bold text** and *italic text* and ***bold italic*** can be combined in sentences. You can also use `inline code` and ~~strikethrough~~ for extra variety.

## Lists

### Nested Unordered List

- Level 1 item A
  - Level 2 item A1
  - Level 2 item A2
    - Level 3 item A2a
- Level 1 item B

### Nested Ordered List

1. First item
   1. Nested first
   2. Nested second
2. Second item
3. Third item

## Tables

| Model | Context | Price |
|-------|---------|-------|
| GPT-4 | 128k | $0.03 |
| Claude | 200k | $0.02 |
| Gemini | 1M | $0.01 |

## Blockquotes

> This is a blockquote
> with multiple lines

> **Nested elements** work too:
> - Lists inside quotes
> - *Formatted text* inside quotes
>
> > And even nested blockquotes!

## Bonus Elements

### Code Block

```python
def hello_world():
    print("Hello, Markdown!")
```

### Horizontal Rule

---

### Links

[Example link](https://example.com) demonstrates hyperlink formatting.

- [x] Text formatting applied
- [x] Lists nested properly
- [x] Table created
- [x] Blockquotes included
